narrative: In the early hours of 5 November 1944, Stirling EH977 'Z' of 1660 Heavy Conversion Unit departed RAF Swinderby on a night training flight. One engine failed in the air. In the confusion that followed — possibly due to crew inexperience — a functioning engine was shut down by mistake rather than the failed one. With two engines out, the aircraft lost control and came down near Bassingham Fen at approximately 02:40 hrs. All seven crew were killed. P/O Robert James Chalmers, the pilot, had joined 1660 HCU only a month earlier, on 2 October 1944.
community_connection: A memorial plaque at Linga Lane, Bassingham Fen, Lincoln LN5 9LD England remembers the crew of 1660 HCU Stirling EH977 'Z'.
